m: अ-श्लाघ्य mfn. not to be praised, base, Mṛcch.
a: अश्लाघ्य — a. 1 Undeserving of praise or honour, worthless. --2 Base, mean, censurable.

v: tri॰ nAsti SrIryasya kap rasya laH । SrIpratikUle SrInASake । “aSlIkametat sADUnAM yatra juhvatyamI haviH” manuH ।

na॰ SriyaM lAti gfhRAti lA--ka rasya laH, SrI + siDmAditvAt la vA na॰ ta॰ । 1 lajjAdisampAdake vAkye 2 grAmyamAzAyAm । “BAskarAlokanASlIla parivAdAMSca varjjayet” yA॰ smf॰ 3 kAvyadozaBede na॰ tacca triviDaM yaTA “duHSravaM triviGASlIlAnucitArTAprayuktatA” sA॰ da॰ aSlIlatvaM vrIqAjugupsAmaNgalavyaYjakatvAttriDA yaTA “dfptArivijaye rAjan! sADanaM sumahattava” “prasasAra SanErvAyuH” । “vinASe tanvi! te sadA” । “atra sADanavAyuvinASaSabdA aSlIlavAcakAH” sA॰ da॰ । tatra sADanaSabdasya SiSnasyApi vAcakatayA vrIqAyAH, vAyuSabdasyApAnavAyuvAcakatayA jugupsAyA, vinASaSabdasya maraRavAcakatayA'maNgalasya ca dyotakatA । yaTAkramaM ca prakfte hetupavanavirahaboDakatAyE prayuktA api te aSlIlavyaYjakatvAdduzwAH । 4 nindAvyaYjake vAkye ca “yamaSrutyASlIlA vA gfcCatIti” tA॰ brA॰ “aSlIlA nindArUpA vAk” BA॰ na SriyaM lAti lA--kaM । 5 aSrIke tri॰ । “yEvEnamasAvaSlIlaM vAg vadati” tA॰ brA॰ “aSlIlamaSrIkaram” BA॰ ।
m: अ-श्लील mfn. = अ-श्रीर, q.v., AV.; ŚBr.; AitBr.
(especially said of speech) coarse, vulgar, Kāṭh.; PBr.; MBh. &c.
अ-श्लील (अम्), n. rustic language, low abuse, Daś.; Sāh. &c.
a: अश्लील — a. [न श्रियं लाति, ला-क] 1 Unpleasant, ugly. --2 Vulgar, obscene, coarse; अश्लीलप्रायान् कलकलान् Dk. 49; ˚परिवार Y. 1. 33. --3 Abusive. --लं 1 Rustic or coarse language, low abuse. --2 (In Rhet.) A fault of composition; using such words as produce in the mind of the hearer a feeling of shame, disgust or inauspiciousness; त्रिधा अश्लीलं; त्रिधेति व्रीडाजुगुप्सामंगलव्यंजकत्वात् K. P. 7; e. g. in साधनं सुमहद्यस्य, मुग्धा कुट्मलिताननेन दधती वायुं स्थिता तत्र सा, and मृदुपवनविभिन्नो मत्प्रियाया विनाशात्, the words साधन, वायु and विनाश are अश्लील, and produce respectively a sense of shame, disgust and inauspiciousness, साधन suggesting the sense of लिंग (male organ of generation), वायु, of the अपान wind (that escaping at the anus), and विनाश, of मृत्यु (death); cf. the instances under S. D. 574; दृप्तारिविजये राजन् साधनं सुमहत्तव . प्रससार शनैर्वायुविंनाशे तन्वि ते तदा ...

k.v: निष्ठुरं परुषं ग्राम्यमश्लीलं सूनृतं प्रिये। सत्येऽथ सङ्कुलक्लिष्टे परस्परपराहतम्.।

m: अ-श्लील—दृढ-रूपा f. (a woman) of an unpleasant but strong figure, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 42.
अ-श्लील—ता, f. or अ-श्लील—त्व, n. rustic language, Sāh. &c.

m: अ-श्लेषा f. sg. or आस्, f. pl. (= आ-श्लेषा, q.v.) N. of the seventh (in later times the ninth) lunar mansion (containing five stars), MBh. xiii, 3262; Jyot.; VarBṛS.
a: अश्लेषा — [न श्लिष्यति यत्रोत्पन्नेन शिशुना, श्लिष्-घञ् Tv.] 1 The 9th Nakṣatra or lunar mansion containing five stars. --2 Disunion, disjunction. --Comp. --जः, --भवः, --भूः N. of Ketu, i. e. the descending node. --शांतिः f. an expiatory ceremony performed on account of the birth of a child under the Aśleṣā.

m: अ-श्लेषा—भव or अ-श्लेषा—भू, m. the Ketu (or descending node), L.

v: strI aSlezAjanananimittA SAntiH SAka॰ ta॰ । aSlezAjanananimittaSAntO । tatra aSlezAjanane dozamAha” jyo॰ ta॰ । “aSvinImaGamUlAnAM gaRqAAdyAstri nAqikAH । antyAH pOzRoragendrARAM paYcEva yavanAH jaguH” mUlendrayordivA gaRqoniSA ca pitfsarpayoH । sanDyAdvaye taTA jYeye revatIturagarkzayoH” sanDyArAtridivABAge gaRqayogodBavaH SiSuH । AtmAnaM mAtaraM tAtaM vittaM hanti yaTAkramam । sarvezAM gaRqajAtAnAM parityAgI viDIyate । tAtenAdarSanaM vApi yAvat zARmAsiko Bavet” jyo॰ ta॰ । tyAgAsAmarTye zaRmAsaparyyantaM muKaM na paSyet SAntyA sarvatra SuBam । tripaYcAdiGawiketyukti rdozabAhulyArTA vastutaH sarvacaraRezveva dozaviSezaH yaTAha nAradaH । “Adye pitA nASamupEti mUlapAde dvitIye jananI tftIye । DanaM caturTe'sya SuBo'sya SAntyA sarvatra tatsyAdahiBe vilomam” । sanDyAdiviSezoktiraDikadozArTA । yaTAha jyotirnibanDaH । “mUlASvipitrya caraRe praTame ca nUnaM pOzRondrayoSca PaRinaSca turIyapAde । mAtuH pituH svavapuzoSca karoti nASaM jAto yadA niSidine'pyaTa sanDyayorvA” । kanyAyAM viSezaH viDAnapArijAte । “na bAlA hanti mUlarkze pitaraM mAtaraM taTA । mUlajA SvaSuraM hanti vyAlajA ca tadaNganAm । mahendrajA'grajaM hanti devarantu dvidevajA । SAntirvA puzkalAsyAccettarhi dozo na kaScana” । dvidevajA aSvinIjAtA tasyAH aSvinIsutadevatAkatvena tayoSca dvitvAt taTAtvam । tacCAntiSca “aSlezAyAntu jAtAnAM SAntiM vakzyAmyataH param jAtasya dvAdaSAhe ca SAntihomaM samAcaret । viBave paYca kumBAMstu dvayaM vA tadaSa ktitaH” ityAdinA mAnavasaMhitoktA । sA ca viDAnapArijAte aSlezASAntiviDAnaprakaraRe dfSyA । tatPalaM ca mantraliNgAt jYeyam mantro yaTA । “aSlezAfkzajAtasya mAtApitrorDanasya ca । BrAtfjYAtikUlasTAnAM dozaM sarvaM vyapohatu । yo'sO vAgISvaro devo hyaDidevo vfhaspatiH । mAtrApitroH SiSoScEva gaRqadozaM vyapohatu । pitaraM sarvaBUtAnAM rakzantu pitaraH sadA । sarpanakzatrajAtasya vittaM jYAtiM ca bAnDavAn” vi॰ pA॰ purA॰ ।
